description: Implement improvements 6, 8, 10 (progress checkpointing/resume, crossfade concatenation, quality gate between segments)
steps: 1. Improvement #6 (Progress checkpointing/resume): Add _save_checkpoint(self, completed_indices, clip_paths, current_image) and _load_checkpoint(self) methods to InfiniteFlowEngine. _save_checkpoint writes JSON to {self.output_dir}/checkpoint.json with: completed_indices (list of int), clip_paths (list of str), bible_state (self.bible._chars), current_image_path (save tensor as PNG to output_dir/checkpoint_frame.png). _load_checkpoint reads the JSON and returns (completed_indices, clip_paths, current_image_tensor) or None if no checkpoint. Add `resume=True` parameter to run(). At the start of each mode method, if resume=True, call _load_checkpoint and skip already-completed indices.

2. Improvement #8 (Transition crossfade): Add a concat_with_crossfade(self, output_name='full_video_crossfade.mp4', duration=0.5) method to InfiniteFlowEngine. Uses ffmpeg's xfade filter to apply crossfade transitions between clips. For N clips, builds a complex filter with xfade between each pair. Use it as the default in scene_chain mode (update the final concatenation in _run() inside CELL 5 to use concat_with_crossfade for scene_chain mode).

3. Improvement #10 (Quality gate): Add a helper function `_validate_frame_quality(frame_tensor: torch.Tensor) -> Tuple[bool, float]` near the other tensor helpers. Checks: brightness mean > 10 and mean < 245 (not too dark/bright), and sharpness via Laplacian variance > 50 (converts to grayscale numpy, applies cv2.Laplacian, checks variance). Returns (is_valid, score). In the generation loops of _run_scene_chain, _run_temporal_extend, and _run_svi_pro_extend, after extracting the last frame, validate it. If it fails, retry generation with seed+1 (max 2 retries). Wrap the generate_clip call in a retry loop.
acceptance_criteria: Mode methods check for checkpoint when resume=True
concat_with_crossfade method exists using ffmpeg xfade filter
scene_chain final concat uses crossfade in CELL 5
_validate_frame_quality function exists with brightness and sharpness checks
Generation loops include quality gate retry logic (max 2 retries)
